Name: Beards & Beaks
Description: Fling an army of feisty gnomes to capture shiny treasure and drive off marauding crows across Gnomeville and the Meadow. Line up boulder shots, field the right mix of gnome types, and unleash mushroom god-powers in this physics puzzler from Microsoft Studios.

Achievements.Name: Pint-sized Hercules
Achievements.Description: Capture a heavy treasure using only 1 gnome without dropping or assisting.

Achievements.Name: Eviction Notice
Achievements.Description: Eject 20 enemies from garrisons.

Achievements.Name: Pull!
Achievements.Description: Hurl 5 or more crows with 1 boulder.

Achievements.Name: Get off Our Lawn!
Achievements.Description: Complete the Gnomeville levels.

Achievements.Name: Meadow Masters
Achievements.Description: Complete the Meadow levels.

Achievements.Name: Team Effort
Achievements.Description: Use at least 4 gnomes to collect a heavy treasure.

Achievements.Name: Solo Performance
Achievements.Description: Complete a multi-gnome level by fielding only 1 gnome.

Achievements.Name: Brothers in Arms
Achievements.Description: Complete a multi-type level with only 1 type of gnome.

Achievements.Name: Divine Intervention
Achievements.Description: Use a mushroom power for the first time.

Achievements.Name: Feather Collector
Achievements.Description: Defeat 100 crows.

Achievements.Name: Putting Hair on Your Chin
Achievements.Description: Complete the first level of Gnomeville.

Achievements.Name: Goaltending
Achievements.Description: Knock 10 treasures out of crow possession right in front of their base.

Achievements.Name: It's Not Called a Bird Paddle
Achievements.Description: Hurl 5 crows into water.

Achievements.Name: A Murder of a Murder
Achievements.Description: Defeat 5 crows in less than 5 seconds.

Achievements.Name: Down to the Wire
Achievements.Description: Finish a base defense level with your bases having less than 10% health remaining.

Achievements.Name: Flickmaster
Achievements.Description: Perform more than 1,000 flicks.

Achievements.Name: Mushroom-Fueled Excess
Achievements.Description: Win a level using every mushroom power.

Achievements.Name: It's Too Quiet
Achievements.Description: On any map with more than 6 crows, sideline all crows at the same time.

Achievements.Name: The Shiny Things Are Mine!
Achievements.Description: Complete the third level of Gnomeville.

Achievements.Name: Savior of Shiny Things
Achievements.Description: You've captured more than 100 treasures.
